statistics.primary_interval: seed-cluster studentized bootstrap-t 95% interval; resample each independent seed with its complete speed/target/period cluster
statistics.position_success_rule: Scheme A: two-sided bootstrap-t interval upper endpoint < 0 and seed-level point estimate <= -MDE; Scheme B: two-sided bootstrap-t interval upper endpoint < -MDE
statistics.studentized_zero_variance_policy: zero observed seed variance or any zero-SE bootstrap replicate makes the interval NOT_EVALUABLE; report point estimate and counts, return null interval endpoints, never claim zero uncertainty
statistics.coverage_interval_zero_variance_policy: zero observed seed-level coverage-difference variance makes the interval NOT_EVALUABLE; report point estimate and counts, return null interval endpoints, never claim zero uncertainty
statistics.missing_seed_policy: retain planned seed registry; missing or invalid seed makes the confirmatory endpoint incomplete; do not replace seeds or silently reduce the denominator
statistics.missing_opportunity_policy: retain all planned target-period opportunities in detection coverage; a missing required opportunity record makes that seed position endpoint NOT_EVALUABLE
statistics.common_success_policy: position RMSE uses only the frozen common correctly-associated opportunity set; every speed must meet the separately approved minimum support; report coverage alongside conditional position error
statistics.tie_policy: strict superiority uses upper endpoint < boundary; detection noninferiority uses lower endpoint > -margin; equality does not pass
statistics.detection_coverage_noninferiority_rule: two-sided paired seed-level t 95% interval lower endpoint for M1-minus-FixedD3 percentage-point coverage difference must be strictly greater than the negative approved margin
statistics.joint_success_rule: approved position rule AND detection-coverage noninferiority; add a track-coverage gate only if explicitly selected and its margin is approved
statistics.method_failure_policy: M1 or Huber prefix estimate failure uses current-period zero correction; every planned opportunity remains in coverage denominators; never substitute another method or reference
statistics.h0_rate_interval_rule: seed-any-event and false-confirmed-track-event rates use two-sided exact Clopper-Pearson intervals and one-sided exact 95% upper bounds for the complete planned seed set; also report the closed-form zero-event upper bound when applicable; do not infer full-system Pfa
statistics.h0_gate_rule: the seed-any-event and false-confirmed-track-event one-sided exact 95% upper bounds must each be strictly below their separately approved limits; require the complete planned H0 seed set
statistics.h0_incomplete_policy: all planned H0 seeds and all ten valid beam-50 periods are required for the confirmatory H0 gate; incomplete seeds do not count as zero-event seeds
statistics.h0_false_track_unit: unique false confirmed TrackManager track ID per independent seed
statistics.secondary_speed_tests: Holm correction across three speeds if inferential p-values are reported
statistics.power_status: screening thresholds are user-approved; realized power is not guaranteed and must not be inferred from this approval
